Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] As At&T (T) Shares Declined, Dubuque Bank & Trust Company Lowered by $428,032 Its Stake; Barton Investment Management Raised Grubhub (GRUB) Position by $313,110 as Shares Rose
May 10, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Dubuque Bank & Trust Company decreased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 45% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dubuque Bank & Trust Company sold 11,264 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 13,766 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $535,000, down from 25,030 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dubuque Bank & Trust Company who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $194.18B market cap company. The stock increased 0.70% or $0.22 $31.62. About 4.76 million shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500.
Barton Investment Management increased its stake in Grubhub (GRUB) by 0.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Barton Investment Management bought 4,410 shares as the company’s stock rose 44.05% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 572,030 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $41.07 million, up from 567,620 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Barton Investment Management who had been investing in Grubhub for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.63 billion market cap company. The stock increased 3.12% or $3.23 $106.68. About 142,508 shares traded. GrubHub Inc. (NYSE:GRUB) has risen 206.92% uptrending. It has outperformed by 195.37% the S&P500.
